item.title: New refugee town inaugurated in Zabul for refugees
item.description: The Ministry of Refugees and Repatriation (MoRR) on Sunday announced the inauguration of the second refugee town in southern Zabul province, providing 5,000 residential plots for returning refugees.

item.title: Turkmen FM visits Herat, stresses acceleration of TAPI project
item.description: Turkmenistan’s Foreign Minister Rashid Meredov has arrived in western Herat province leading a high-level delegation to review progress on the Turkmenistan–Afghanistan–Pakistan–India (TAPI) gas pipeline project and to enhance economic and transit cooperation.

item.title: Baradar travels to Herat for talks with Turkmen FM
item.description: Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs Mullah Abdul Ghani Baradar travelled to western Herat province on Sunday to hold an official meeting with Turkmenistan’s Foreign Minister Rashid Meredov.

item.title: Afghan, Turkmen officials discuss key economic, infrastructure projects
item.description: Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs Mullah Abdul Ghani Baradar and Turkmenistan’s Foreign Minister Rashid Meredov have discussed major economic and infrastructure projects, including the Turkmenistan–Afghanistan–Pakistan–India (TAPI) gas pipeline, electricity supply and regional connectivity.

item.title: Pakistan to boycott 2026 T20 WC match against India
item.description: Pakistan will boycott their Group A match against India at the 2026 ICC T20 World Cup, ESPNcricinfo has reported.

item.title: Afghanistan, Scotland to meet in warm-up match today
item.description: Afghanistan are all set to take on Scotland in its first warm-up match of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup today (Monday) at the BCCI Centre of Excellence Ground 1 in Bengaluru, India.

item.title: 8 Islamic countries condemn Israel’s repeated ceasefire violations in Gaza
item.description: Eight Islamic countries have strongly condemned Israel’s repeated violations of the Gaza ceasefire.
